summary: Iteration 3 full test of the nav/structure/register/map batch. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (14 existing + 9 new for /api/registrations and project lat/lng). Frontend: all 9 requested flows verified on desktop (1920x1080), mobile (390x844) and tablet (768x1024). Header Services dropdown works (4 items, Architecture opens https://nakshaabanwao.com/ in new tab, outside-click closes). Calculator & Contact removed from top-level header nav. Mobile hamburger menu shows Services section with 4 inline sub-items. Footer Explore column has all 7 anchor links (projects/services/calculator/packages/about/reviews/contact) + Register with us Link to /register. /register page renders with 3 tabs (vendor/channel_partner/hiring); submitted all 3 forms end-to-end via UI, got success toast each, forms reset. Projects section shows Ongoing(37)/Completed(260) tabs, default is Ongoing, result count updates on tab change (37 projects on Ongoing, 260 on Completed). Real Leaflet+OpenStreetMap tiles render (9 tiles on mobile, 3 clusters on tablet). Marker clusters show numeric count bubbles. Locality filter correctly scopes within selected tab.

issues: Package chip row (All/Essential/Signature/Premium) overflows the viewport horizontally and clips 'Premium' chip off-screen — chips row needs flex-wrap or horizontal scroll on <400px widths.

action_items: Minor: ProjectsMap filter package chip row overflows on 390px mobile — add flex-wrap or overflow-x-auto to the chip container so 'Premium' is not clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectsMap.jsx map container uses `min-h-[460px] lg:min-h-[720px]` but the parent Reveal wrapper does NOT set height on the map div for mobile. Map renders at the min-height, which is fine, but if the MapContainer ever receives 0px height before data loads, Leaflet will stay collapsed — not observed here because min-h is set.

RegisterForms.jsx line 42: `[cfg.extra]: f.extra || undefined` uses computed property on the mutation payload — works, but means the local state key is always `extra` while the backend field name varies per type. This is fine functionally but slightly confusing; worth a comment.
Navbar.jsx servicesRef mousedown listener closes dropdown on outside click but does NOT close it on Escape key — minor a11y gap, non-blocking.

Backend server.py registrations endpoint has no server-side validation that `type` ∈ {vendor, channel_partner, hiring}. Any string is accepted. Low risk (UI constrains it) but should be a Literal[...] in the Pydantic model.
seed_data_creation: 3 UI-submitted test registrations (TEST_UI_Vendor / TEST_UI_CP / TEST_UI_Hire) + 3 pytest-created test registrations (TEST_Vendor / TEST_CP / TEST_Hire) now live in db.registrations collection.
